LEGEND.TITLE: Understand each column
LEGEND.RECEIVED: Received: how many conversations reached this person. The Total is the sum of the next columns (someone handed + round robin + took it + other).
LEGEND.RECEIVED_MANUAL: Someone handed it: a colleague or manager gave the conversation to this person.
LEGEND.RECEIVED_AUTO: Round robin: the system distributed it by itself.
LEGEND.SELF_ASSIGNED: Took it: the person took the conversation.
LEGEND.ASSIGNED_TO_OTHERS: To colleagues: conversations this person handed to someone else.
LEGEND.RECEIVED_OTHER: Other: it came from the AI, an automation rule, the API, or in a way the system did not record.
